notes.title: TAD: That Alien Dude v. 1.0.5 RELEASED!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32332559/441ab389bdc0db2ef16cbbcf2de96d3075fb5f86.gif[/img]

[h1]The Wait Is Over![/h1]

[i]TAD: That Alien Dude[/i] has been released.  Currently in version 1.0.5, this premiere version of the game features updated dialog, original music, original animation, and a wacky storyline.

While not an "Early Access" release, please understand that you can expect [i]TAD[/i] to evolve from here (and not via DLCs or via any other kind of paid content).  [i]TAD[/i] is a work of love, and as such, the development will continue with criticism from the game community being taken very seriously. 

[h1]Changes from 1.0.0-4 to 1.0.5[/h1]

* Fusionist level now has full walls and proper layering included
* Dialog boxes have been improved to match style of the game 
* Major bug wherein the game could not be completed if not completed on the first try by the player has been squashed
* Sound issues improved

[h1]Planned updates for upcoming releases[/h1]

* Improved enemy animations 
* Side quests with new Toon Alley pals
* More cutscenes and an intro
* Open World access to all levels and side quests
* Save game states
* Suggestions always welcome!
